text: ANDREY (ergonomics): dogfood recording = too many calls. Want consolidated one-call record (task upsert + milestones + body + doc links) or batch endpoint, idempotent, returns ids. Composes with handoff.

ANDREY refinement: embed ergonomics into CLI + app/daemon side, not just an orchestrator workaround — app UI + all agents record via the same consolidated path. Batch endpoint used by both CLI and in-app.

ERGONOMICS synth (codex): friction = 4-7 calls per provenance update. SOLUTION: one consolidated 'codeterm plan record' backed by POST /api/plans/:id/batch — ordered typed ops with client ids + $ref resolution ([upsert_task, set_task_body, add_milestone, add_element...]), ONE daemon transaction, ONE plan write, ONE plan-changed, returns all ids. Idempotency via --key or {pane,command_hash,minute_bucket}; upsert task by handle; milestone de-dupe (task,kind,key). 'plan handoff create' internally calls the same batch service. Implement batch service first/alongside handoff; expose 'plan record' as the ergonomic path used by CLI AND in-app.
Part 1 batch service is live on dev: atomic apply_batch, plan.batch RPC/REST route, plan record CLI, and agent report plan milestones through batch.
Part 1 batch service LIVE (feat/canvas-handoff 36b1d056): apply_batch + POST /batch + plan.batch RPC + plan record CLI + agent report routed via batch; 186 CLI tests green.
6-calls-to-1 achieved; this milestone recorded via codeterm plan record in ONE call.
